SELECT CASE WHEN i.kind = 'machine_overheat' THEN 'machine_overheat' ELSE 'other' END AS incident_group, COUNT(*) AS incident_count, ROUND(AVG(w.temperature_c), 1) AS mean_temperature_c, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN w.temperature_c > 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100, 1) AS share_above_30c_pct FROM sf_ops.incidents i JOIN sf_plant.weather_hourly w ON date_trunc('HOUR', i.ts) = w.ts GROUP BY CASE WHEN i.kind = 'machine_overheat' THEN 'machine_overheat' ELSE 'other' END ORDER BY incident_count DESC
LIMIT 200
